description: This file contains a unit test for the Core::NodeId class, verifying its behavior using the Google Test framework.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node identifier, providing details such as hostname, address, and port.

methods.name: NodeId
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a NodeId object with a hostname string.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname part of the NodeId.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type or protocol information associated with the NodeId.

methods.name: PortNumber
methods.description: Returns the port number associated with the NodeId.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks whether the NodeId is valid.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size or length of the NodeId data.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the host.

methods.name: QualifiedName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name of the node.

methods.name: IsLocalInterface
methods.description: Indicates if the NodeId corresponds to a local network interface.

methods.name: IsAnyInterface
methods.description: Indicates if the NodeId corresponds to any network interface.

methods.name: IsMulticast
methods.description: Indicates if the NodeId is a multicast address.

methods.name: DefaultMask
methods.description: Returns the default network mask associated with the NodeId.
